packageRules.description: Group Next.js + React (web workspace) — they release in lockstep Declared locally rather than in the shared preset, and it must stay local: the preset's eslint-stack rule matches eslint-config-* and would otherwise pull eslint-config-next away from the framework it is versioned against. A consumer's packageRules are appended after the preset's and later rules win, so this one correctly reclaims it.
